avis.texte: It’s a good mask. I have used it twice and feel that it’s hydrating. It comes with plenty of serum. It’s a thicker mask and stays hydrating longer than the suggested 20 min. My only small complaint is that the mask is huge. Bigger than any other mask I’ve tried (I’m a mask-aholic). Would be great for bigger faces. Because of the size, it does start falling off if you’re standing up.

avis.titre: Luxurious, thick sheet mask that feels amazingLuxurious, thick sheet mask that feels amazing
avis.texte: This sheet mask is thick and fluffy, and it’s soaked with plenty of luxurious essence. It feels very comfortable on the skin and I highly recommend it. The sheet is quite wide, so I fold it slightly on the sides when I use it since I have a longer face.

I had no Idea what "Glass Skin" is until I saw a video from a model the other day. For me, this mask made my skin sooo youthful looking, and it had a "glass skin look" for real. Thoroughly impressed. One thing, if you have a petite face and head, it's huge!! Lol They most definitely need different sizes. Other than that, Great!! 💯

avis.titre: My favorite high quality pdrn mask!My favorite high quality pdrn mask!
avis.texte: I am very familiar with this brand for awhile now. I love it. I love how this sheet mask is powered by salmon DNA PDRN and c-PDRN to leave my skin looking smoother, firmer, and more radiant. It gives my complexion a refreshed, healthy-looking glow while helping improve elasticity and overall skin vitality. The blend of salmon serum and purified salmon sperm extract provides intense hydration and nourishment. My skin feels soothed, deeply moisturized, and the moisture barrier looks stronger, with a softer, more even-looking texture. I appreciate the advanced c-PDRN technology, which helps support collagen production and minimizes the appearance of fine lines. It's become one of my favorite treatments whenever my skin needs extra care or a revitalizing boost. The ultra-soft microfiber sheet fits my face comfortably and stays in place, allowing the essence to absorb well. It leaves my skin feeling calm, hydrated, and refreshed long after I remove the mask. I also like that Rejuran delivers high-quality Korean skincare that's cruelty-free and free of parabens, sulfates, and other harsh ingredients. It gives me confidence knowing I'm using a gentle, effective mask that prioritizes both skin health and safety. Good value for the money. A++ Its one of the best masks I've used. I hope my review was helpful to you. Have a lovely day!
Refreshing. Easy to use and leaves your skin feeling hydrated and glowing. Fits your face perfectly and a great value for your money.

I like to use this mask after I’ve had micro-needling done. After a micro-needling session my skin is dry for a few days so I like to use the Rejuran mask to lock in moisture. It’s also good to use just to reduce pores and give you smooth/soft skin.
My favorite hydrating mask that never fails. I use it a few hours before going out. My skin glows!
It's so great a moisturizing product. A lot of esscence and can last long time. After masking, I squeezed the esscence to leave on skin. Will definetly re-order for future.

avis.titre: by far one of my favourite masks
avis.texte: i’m a big user of collagen masks, Korean masks, glass skin masks etc. This is an absolute favourite. I used it once my skin was amazing immediately after and the following day. I could actually feel something happening, which I don’t feel when I use my other mask.

avis.titre: モチモチ肌を実感！リジュラン ターンオーバーマスクモチモチ肌を実感！リジュラン ターンオーバーマスク
avis.texte: 肌がなんとなくゴワついてきた感じがして、話題になっていたこちらのリジュランターンオーバーマスクを使ってみました。 開けた瞬間、美容液の量がすごくてびっくりしました！ マスク自体も厚めでしっかりしているし、肌への密着感もなかなか良いです。 時間をおいて外したあとは、しっとりモチモチ。特に翌朝の肌の手触りが全然違っていて、メイクのりもよくなりました。 私は乾燥肌で、特にエアコンの季節はガサガサになりやすいのですが、これはかなり潤いが長続きしてくれて助かります。 ただ、少しだけサイズが大きめで、目元のフィット感には少し工夫が必要かもしれません。 でもその分、フェイスラインまでしっかりケアできるのが嬉しいです。 スペシャルケアとして週1～2回使うのが楽しみになってます。 贅沢な使用感なのにコスパもそこまで悪くないので、今後もリピ予定です！
Love the mask, skin felt great and I used make up on top looked amazing
Lovely moisturising mask that left skin glowing and healthy looking.
